$comment: DOCUMENTS THE CMP/WASM PLAYER CANNOT DRAW YET, temporarily allowed past the gate design-artifacts.yml enforces. Every entry names the player gap and expires, because an allowlist that does not expire is a gate that has been switched off. An entry whose id no longer exists is WORSE than no entry: it protects nothing while making the list look maintained. Take ids from the lane's own output - the `CMP/Wasm: n/m rendered` block prints them - rather than from previews.json, whose spelling of the frame differs. The list is empty: every remote-m3 document renders in the CMP/Wasm lane. REMOVED 2026-09-30: the four `ThemeSpecimen*Remote` entries (the google:Inter family now resolves from the vendored font manifest) and the fifty-eight `LinearProgressRemote` / `VerticalPageIndicatorRemote_*_VARIANT_left*` entries. Those were filed as an upstream Compose Wasm graphics-layer bug that rc-players routed around by excluding MODIFIER_GRAPHICS_LAYER from its Wasm profile. There was no such bug: on rc-players 2.0.2, which no longer excludes it (yschimke/rc-players#547), all fifty-eight render in strict mode and match the baked frames to within 0.015% of pixels. An allowlist entry is about whether the lane can render a document at all, not about whether the picture is right. Earlier removals (2026-09-02): the four `ImageBackgroundRemoteButton` entries, once paint commands 22 (SHADER_MATRIX) and 24 (TEXTURE) were implemented; both players render the same opaque container, a separate defect tracked on https://github.com/yschimke/wear-m3-catalog/issues/157.
